package answer

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

// StartTaskAnswerInput carries details for starting attempt.
type StartTaskAnswerInput struct {
	StudentID          string
	TaskID             string
	LearningPathItemID string
	RequirementID      string
}

type StartTaskAnswerOutput struct {
	AnswerID               string
	LearningActionID       string
	SandboxID              string
	Status                 string
	PreviewURL             string
	Type                   int16
	TaskKind               string
	ExecutionMode          string
	EvaluationMode         string
	UIMode                 string
	SubmissionMode         string
	RequiresSandbox        bool
	ExposesPreview         bool
	ExposesTerminal        bool
	SupportsLiveValidation bool
	TerminalWSURL          string
}

// StartTaskAnswer starts attempt ensuring limits and task availability.
type StartTaskAnswer struct {
	TaskProvider        TaskProvider
	LessonAssignments   LessonAssessmentTaskResolver
	Answers             repository.StudentTaskAnswerRepository
	LearningActions     repository.LearningActionLifecycleRepository
	Publisher           domain.EventPublisher
	SandboxCreator      domain.SandboxCreator
	Progression         *ProgressionService
	PracticeTaskRuntime PracticeTaskRuntimeBridge
}

var defaultComposeConfig = json.RawMessage(`{
  "version": "3.9",
  "services": {
    "app": {
      "image": "node:20-alpine",
      "working_dir": "/workspace",
      "command": [
        "sh",
        "-c",
        "while true; do sleep 3600; done"
      ]
    }
  }
}`)

// Handle creates a new attempt if allowed.
func (uc StartTaskAnswer) Handle(ctx context.Context, in StartTaskAnswerInput) (StartTaskAnswerOutput, error) {
	if (in.LearningPathItemID == "") != (in.RequirementID == "") {
		return StartTaskAnswerOutput{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	var task *TaskMetadata
	var err error
	if in.LearningPathItemID != "" {
		if _, err := uuid.Parse(in.LearningPathItemID); err != nil {
			return StartTaskAnswerOutput{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if _, err := uuid.Parse(in.RequirementID); err != nil {
			return StartTaskAnswerOutput{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if uc.LessonAssignments == nil || uc.LearningActions == nil {
			return StartTaskAnswerOutput{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		task, err = uc.LessonAssignments.ResolveAssessmentTask(ctx, in.StudentID, in.LearningPathItemID, in.RequirementID, in.TaskID)
	} else {
		task, err = uc.TaskProvider.GetTask(WithTaskLookupContext(ctx, in.StudentID, ""), in.TaskID)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return StartTaskAnswerOutput{}, err
	}
	if task == nil {
		return StartTaskAnswerOutput{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	task = NormalizeTaskMetadata(task)
	if task.Status != domain.TaskStatusActive {
		return StartTaskAnswerOutput{}, domain.ErrInvalidStatus
	}
	if isPracticeTaskRuntimeTask(task) {
		if task.Locked {
			return StartTaskAnswerOutput{}, &TaskLockedError{
				TaskID:           in.TaskID,
				RedirectLessonID: task.RedirectLessonID,
				RedirectTaskID:   task.RedirectTaskID,
			}
		}
	} else if in.LearningPathItemID == "" && uc.Progression != nil {
		access, err := uc.Progression.ResolveTaskAccess(ctx, in.StudentID, in.TaskID)
		if err != nil {
			return StartTaskAnswerOutput{}, err
		}
		if access.Locked {
			return StartTaskAnswerOutput{}, &TaskLockedError{
				TaskID:           in.TaskID,
				RedirectLessonID: access.RedirectLessonID,
				RedirectTaskID:   access.RedirectTaskID,
			}
		}
	}
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	var created domain.StudentTaskAnswer
	var learningAction domain.StudentLearningAction
	if isPracticeTaskRuntimeTask(task) {
		// Reopen/resume stays on the same active answer while the milestone is in progress.
		// A new answer is created only after the previous one has already been finalized.
		if active, activeErr := uc.Answers.GetActiveForTaskAndStudent(ctx, in.TaskID, in.StudentID); activeErr == nil && active != nil {
			created = *active
			if uc.LearningActions != nil {
				candidate, actionErr := newLearningAction(created, task, now)
				if actionErr != nil {
					return StartTaskAnswerOutput{}, actionErr
				}
				learningAction, actionErr = uc.LearningActions.EnsureActive(ctx, candidate)
				if actionErr != nil {
					return StartTaskAnswerOutput{}, actionErr
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if created.ID == "" {
		answer := domain.StudentTaskAnswer{
			ID:        uuid.NewString(),
			StudentID: in.StudentID,
			TaskID:    in.TaskID,
			StartedAt: now,
			Status:    domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusInProgress,
			CreatedAt: now,
			UpdatedAt: now,
		}
		if in.LearningPathItemID != "" {
			answer.LearningPathItemID = in.LearningPathItemID
			answer.RequirementID = in.RequirementID
			answer.FrozenTaskJSON, err = json.Marshal(task)
			if err != nil {
				return StartTaskAnswerOutput{}, err
			}
		}
		if uc.LearningActions != nil {
			candidate, actionErr := newLearningAction(answer, task, now)
			if actionErr != nil {
				return StartTaskAnswerOutput{}, actionErr
			}
			created, learningAction, err = uc.LearningActions.CreateAnswer(ctx, answer, task.MaxAttempts, candidate)
		} else {
			created, err = uc.Answers.Create(ctx, answer, task.MaxAttempts)
		}
		if err != nil {
			return StartTaskAnswerOutput{}, err
		}
		if uc.Publisher != nil {
			_ = uc.Publisher.Publish(domain.SubjectTaskAnswerStarted, map[string]any{
				"task_id":                in.TaskID,
				"user_id":                in.StudentID,
				"student_task_answer_id": created.ID,
				"learning_action_id":     learningAction.ID,
				"course_id":              task.CourseID,
				"attempt":                created.Attempt,
				"started_at":             now,
			})
		}
	}

	out := StartTaskAnswerOutput{
		AnswerID:               created.ID,
		LearningActionID:       learningAction.ID,
		Status:                 "IN_PROCESS",
		Type:                   task.Type,
		TaskKind:               task.TaskKind,
		ExecutionMode:          task.ExecutionMode,
		EvaluationMode:         task.EvaluationMode,
		UIMode:                 task.UIMode,
		SubmissionMode:         task.SubmissionMode,
		RequiresSandbox:        task.RequiresSandbox,
		ExposesPreview:         task.ExposesPreview,
		ExposesTerminal:        task.ExposesTerminal,
		SupportsLiveValidation: task.SupportsLiveValidation,
	}
	if !task.RequiresSandbox {
		return out, nil
	}
	if uc.SandboxCreator == nil {
		return StartTaskAnswerOutput{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}

	composeConfig := resolveComposeConfig(task.ComposeConfig)
	sandboxID, previewURL, err := uc.SandboxCreator.CreateSandbox(
		ctx,
		in.StudentID,
		in.TaskID,
		created.ID,
		composeConfig,
		task.CodeStructureType,
		task.CodeStructure,
		pickStarterArchiveID(task.StarterFiles),
	)
	if err != nil {
		return StartTaskAnswerOutput{}, fmt.Errorf("create sandbox: %w", err)
	}
	out.SandboxID = sandboxID
	if task.ExposesPreview {
		out.PreviewURL = previewURL
	}
	if uc.PracticeTaskRuntime != nil && isPracticeTaskRuntimeTask(task) {
		preview := previewURL
		if err := uc.PracticeTaskRuntime.BindAnswer(ctx, in.StudentID, in.TaskID, created.ID, sandboxID, &preview); err != nil {
			return StartTaskAnswerOutput{}, err
		}
	}
	return out, nil
}

func pickStarterArchiveID(items []TaskStarterFileMetadata) string {
	for _, item := range items {
		if item.Type == 1 && item.FileStorageID != "" {
			return item.FileStorageID
		}
	}
	return ""
}

func resolveComposeConfig(raw json.RawMessage) json.RawMessage {
	trimmed := bytes.TrimSpace(raw)
	if len(trimmed) == 0 || bytes.Equal(trimmed, []byte("null")) {
		return defaultComposeConfig
	}

	var payload any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(trimmed, &payload); err != nil {
		return trimmed
	}

	root, ok := payload.(map[string]any)
	if !ok {
		return trimmed
	}

	servicesRaw, ok := root["services"]
	if !ok {
		return defaultComposeConfig
	}

	switch services := servicesRaw.(type) {
	case map[string]any:
		if len(services) == 0 {
			return defaultComposeConfig
		}
	case map[any]any:
		if len(services) == 0 {
			return defaultComposeConfig
		}
	default:
		return defaultComposeConfig
	}

	return trimmed
}
